usedFor: Signable sends documents for signature, and Google Sheets logs them when “Add New Row to Sheet” follows “Envelope Signed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Envelope Signed” in Signable, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every signed envelope adds a row, giving you a live record of what has been signed.

watchOut: “Add New Row to Sheet” maps values to columns, so check the column mapping once before relying on it.
